format_contract.indent: two spaces per nesting level, and a wrapped line continues its item at the item's indent plus two. A line indented six or more spaces renders monospace ONLY when it is a table row (three or more internal spaces, or two or more with a monospace sibling at the same indent) or a verbatim shape (a token carrying one of = -> / \ < > { } [ ] or two digits, in a line that is not three consecutive lowercase words). Prose at six or more spaces renders as prose and joins the item above it, so a six-space indent never makes prose stand out. Set a verbatim block off with a blank line above and below, and give a table three-space column gaps
format_contract.editorial_markers: HTML comments <!-- v149: ... --> mark content written from PLAN_v149 rather than from shipped code. Strip them before display; act on them before shipping.

honesty_gate.mechanism: app.py --selftest calls guide_tour.bad_headings(app, PANEL_GUIDE). It asserts that every ALL-CAPS line (from line 2 on) of PANEL_GUIDE and of every view here with gate='section_headings' AND live!=false is either '<TAB> > <SECTION>' built from the live _group titles, or starts with LEFT PANEL / TOP BAR / PLOT AREA.
honesty_gate.live_flag: A view is checked unless it carries "live": false. That flag is how a view written ahead of its panel ships without breaking the gate; the patch that builds the panel flips it to true in the same change.
honesty_gate.rule_for_those_files: line 1 is the view title and is exempt (matching PANEL_GUIDE's own convention). Every other ALL-CAPS line in these six files is a valid gated heading - checked mechanically against the live _group titles. Sub-topics and prose headings inside them are deliberately Title Case so they cannot trip the gate.
